subject: Next steps: integration staging & deployment mode decision
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Mendes <olivia.mendes@medintel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: integration staging & deployment mode decision

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights
- MedIntel wants an LLM-powered summarization pipeline to run on clinical notes; primary concerns are data isolation, encryption at rest, and predictable latency for real-time UI.
- Team is leaning toward a Private VPC or Dedicated capacity; Hosted API acceptable if we can prove isolation/controls and latency.
- Procurement wants a clear PoC scope, timeline, and success criteria before internal approval.

Proposed PoC approach (high level)
- Phase A (integration & sanity): 2 weeks — connect a sandbox data subset, validate model selection and latency on sample queries.
- Phase B (security + gating): 2 weeks — KMS integration, audit log verification, SOC2 evidence mapping.
- Phase C (load & SLA): 2 weeks — sustained throughput test with representative traffic; validate p95/p99 latency targets.

Success criteria (draft)
1) Functional: summaries match baseline eval on our rubric (ROUGE + human pass rate >= 85%).
2) Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for median session size.
3) Security: VPC peering or Private deployment with KMS key ops in place; audit logs forwarded to MedIntel SIEM.
4) Cost sanity: projected cost per 1k tokens within the budget band we discussed.

Stakeholders to confirm
- MedIntel: Olivia (engineering), procurement@medintel.com (procurement), security lead TBD.
- Redwood: Ben (sales, PoC owner), Marissa (solutions), Karthik (deployment lead).

Next steps
1) Olivia: confirm which deployment modes you want scoped for the PoC (Private VPC, Dedicated, Hosted API with controls) — please reply by EOD Wednesday.
2) Ben/Redwood: we'll circulate the PoC checklist and a proposed timeline immediately (attaching checklist).
3) Procurement: share any contractual gating items now so we can incorporate them into the DocuSign path.

Attachment: Redwood-POC-Checklist.xlsx (stub) — contains detailed tasks, owners, and environment requirements.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Olivia Mendes <olivia.mendes@medintel.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medintel.com
Date: 2026-11-10T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: integration staging & deployment mode decision

Ben — thanks for the succinct recap. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with security and product: 

1) Deployment modes: our preference is Private VPC for full isolation. Dedicated capacity is a close second if VPC networking proves complicated. Hosted API is a last resort — acceptable only if you can provide strong, auditable tenant isolation and encryption with customer-managed keys.

2) Security gating items (procurement included):
- Proof of KMS integration and key custody model (who can rotate keys).
- Audit log format/schema and retention policy (our SIEM must ingest logs).
- SOC2 Type II report and any additional attestation documents — we attached some baseline requirements in a PDF (see attachment).

3) Timeline: procurement is pushing for a 6-week PoC window (including sign-off). Can you compress phases A–C into 4 weeks with parallel work? If not, explain dependencies.

4) Success criteria nuance: for latency, our web UI experience team wants p95 <= 250ms under the PoC load. Also need an ops runbook that triggers failover to a lower-cost tier if latency degrades.

We'll confirm the named security lead tomorrow and loop them on the checklist.

— Olivia
Olivia Mendes
Head of Engineering, Integrations | MedIntel
olivia.mendes@medintel.com

Attachment: MedIntel-Security-Responses.pdf (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Mendes <olivia.mendes@medintel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medintel.com
Date: 2026-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: integration staging & deployment mode decision

Hi Olivia — appreciate the detail. Short answers and a refined plan below: 

On deployment modes
- We'll scope the PoC with Private VPC as primary and Dedicated as a fallback. Technical team will validate VPC peering/ENI setup in parallel with Dedicated provisioning to try and meet your compressed timeline.

On security gating
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM; we'll document rotation roles and show a demo during phase B.
- Audit logs: we will stream structured audit events to your SIEM (supporting JSON lines); retention/forwarding are configurable.
- SOC2: we'll provide the latest Type II report and a short mapping doc against your checklist (link below).

On timeline and parallelization
- Proposed compressed plan (4 weeks):
  Week 1 — infra & sandbox integration (VPC setup + Dedicated baseline), model selection, quick functional tests.
  Week 2 — security integrations (KMS, audit log forwarding) + run initial functional eval.
  Week 3 — load testing and latency tuning (autoscale policies / batch configs).
  Week 4 — acceptance, runbook handover, and executive sign-off.

This requires Redwood to provision a Dedicated slice and for MedIntel to approve a CIDR block for VPC peering within 3 business days of kickoff. If peering is delayed >5 business days, Dedicated fallback becomes the working plan.

Operational commitments from Redwood
- Redwood will assign a deployment engineer (Karthik) and a solutions lead (Marissa) to be on weekly syncs and on-call during load tests.
- We'll prepare the runbook that includes automatic fallback rules (e.g., route to cheaper instance type and throttle batch sizes).

I'll open a DocuSign envelope for the PoC SOW and expedited MSA amendments. Procurement, please watch for that — Ben will nudge if not received by tomorrow.

Link: HubSpot deal DL-7832 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-7832)

Ben
